column1: # t_creature_ability: value -> keyword, read from the exe table of {i32 value; char* keyword}
# pairs at VA 0xa64160..0xa64410 (0x56 entries, sorted by keyword; built into a keyword map
# at VA 0xab0558 by the static initializer at VA 0x63e650). Values are the enum numbers as is.
# Earlier versions of this file paired each keyword with the next entry's value minus one,
# which was wrong wherever keyword order and value order differ.
# checked against combat damage code: fire_attack/fire_resistance, cold_attack/cold_resistance,
# ranged, undead, elemental, stone_gaze (0x42 with effect 0x98 = spell stone_gaze)
